visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat five-step contact wizards and generic 'get in touch' pages: one-screen V3Ask, local brokers with real phone numbers as doors, FAQ as disclosures.
note: Live 2026-09-03 leftover. Order is Breadcrumb, Quiet (H1 Call, text, or write), V3Doors (call/text, email, book), V3Ask (one screen, every field, one button — not the old five-step sheet), V3Ledger (who answers), V3Answers (CONTACT_FAQ_ITEMS as disclosures), Footer. Consent checkbox is padded to --v3-tap on this route without changing SMS_CONSENT_TEXT. tasteReview is withheld until a separate evaluator grades the rendered page (design_system/public/TASTE.md). Do not invent a score.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Contact. Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Opens the page. H1 is Call, text, or write (or the CMS title when it is not a bare Contact). One true line. Listing summary door when ?listingKey= is present.

requiredComponents.name: V3Doors
requiredComponents.section: The three fastest reaches, above the form: call/text, email, book. A visitor who wants a human should not have to find a form field first.

requiredComponents.name: ContactAsk
requiredComponents.section: One-screen V3Ask. Same submitContactForm fields as the old five-step sheet. SMS consent checkbox padded to 44px on this route. Consent copy is SMS_CONSENT_TEXT, untouched.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Who answers. One row per broker from getBrokers, Matt-Rebecca-Paul, door to /team.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: CONTACT_FAQ_ITEMS as native disclosures, remaining edges in the rail. splitQuietItems at the page so a leftover prose row cannot vanish.

deferredComponents.name: V3Sheet
deferredComponents.reason: The five-step sheet was the problem this page left. Ask is the whole form at once.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Contact is not a media page. The ask is the job.

deferredComponents.name: V3Proof
deferredComponents.reason: Reviews live on /reviews. A proof band here would restated that page.

removedComponents: Five-step V3Sheet contact wizard (Matt 2026-09-01: how they get hold of us must be simple).
sectionOrder: V3SectionTracker + ContactPage / BreadcrumbList / FAQPage JSON-LD (not sections)
V3Quiet #contact -- H1 and the one true line

tasteReview.beats: Cascade Sotheby's Bend contact page on personal accountability: three named, licensed brokers with OR license numbers, direct phone and email, and honest copy ('answer you personally') with zero unverified SLA claims (curl: zero 'business day' hits on /contact and the ?listingKey= tour variant). Still loses to Zillow's contact-agent flow on measured response time: Zillow surfaces a data-backed 'usually responds in X'; this page says nothing quantified about speed, which is honest but not yet the differentiator. The false claim was subtracted, not replaced with a true, sourced one.
tasteReview.evaluator: separate Sonnet evaluator, SITE-09 response-clock pass 2, contact page class (pass 1: 43, same model, same day)

firstPass.evaluator: separate Sonnet evaluator, SITE-09 response-clock pass 1, contact page class

fixedFromThisPass: Honesty: meta/og/twitter description no longer promises a reply within one business day; verified live on /contact and the tour variant, zero hits in the rendered HTML.
Taste: call/text/email/schedule appear once, in the doors row; the hero carries the intro line, the office address, and the listing door on the tour variant.
Taste: the sent state echoes the submission ('Sent: Buying') and offers two next actions (pick a time, send another message) instead of one bare door.
Craft: the SMS consent checkbox measures 44 by 44 at 375 in the DOM; the pass-1 finding was withdrawn.
openRaise: Page composition: hero, form, brokers and FAQ still run as four consecutive eyebrow, heading, rows, hairline sections (the stacked-section tell); fold the brokers band into the hero/doors area or give one section a different form.

Response clock on the page: replace the removed SLA with a sourced figure once the rails have stamped enough rows ('brokers typically reply in N minutes, from the last N inquiries', with the section-0 trace from getResponseClockReport); today the median is unproven, so nothing ships.
Brokers roster: a flat hairline row; give it visual weight (larger headshots, a specialty line).
FAQ: a plain three-item accordion; a stronger form or a disclosure beside a display.
Full-page desktop capture shows the broker avatars as gray boxes while the viewport crop shows the photos: a lazy-load capture artifact to confirm on first paint.

defects.finding: Hero, form, brokers and FAQ repeat the same eyebrow-heading-rows-hairline shape end to end.
Flat list row per broker with no visual encoding beyond hairlines.
Plain three-item accordion with no figure, image or interaction beyond expand/collapse.
The false SLA was removed but no sourced response-time figure replaces it yet.

tasteReview.note: SITE-09 (response clock). /contact had no prior tasteReview (unreviewed baseline); pass 1 set the first mark and pass 2 graded the fixes. Admin panel shots are the CRM flag surface for the same node, not a public page.
